destinations.name: Toronto
destinations.description: Canada's largest city — a lakeside metropolis of distinct neighbourhoods, world-class museums, and one of the most diverse food scenes on the planet.

activities.name: CN Tower
activities.description: Iconic 553m tower with glass floor, lookout levels and 360-degree views of the city and lake.

activities.name: CN Tower EdgeWalk
activities.description: Hands-free walk around the CN Tower's outer ledge, 356m above the ground. Thrill of a lifetime.

activities.name: Ripley's Aquarium of Canada
activities.description: Massive aquarium at the base of the CN Tower with a moving walkway through a shark tunnel.

activities.name: Royal Ontario Museum
activities.description: Canada's largest museum — dinosaurs, world cultures, and the striking crystal facade.

activities.name: Art Gallery of Ontario
activities.description: Frank Gehry-redesigned gallery with Canadian art, the Group of Seven, and major international exhibitions.

activities.name: Casa Loma
activities.description: A 98-room Gothic Revival castle with secret tunnels, towers, and sprawling gardens.

activities.name: Distillery District
activities.description: Victorian-era distillery turned pedestrian village of galleries, boutiques and patios.

activities.name: St. Lawrence Market
activities.description: Historic indoor market famous for peameal bacon sandwiches, cheese, and fresh produce.

activities.name: Kensington Market
activities.description: Bohemian neighbourhood of vintage shops, street food, and colourful murals — great for wandering.

activities.name: Graffiti Alley
activities.description: A kilometre of ever-changing street art — Toronto's most photographed laneway.

activities.name: Toronto Islands Ferry
activities.description: Short ferry ride to car-free islands with beaches, bike rentals, and the best skyline views.

activities.name: High Park
activities.description: Toronto's largest park — trails, gardens, a small zoo, and cherry blossoms in spring.

activities.name: Harbourfront Centre
activities.description: Lakeside promenade with festivals, free concerts, and kayak rentals in summer.

activities.name: Nathan Phillips Square
activities.description: The city's gathering place with the iconic TORONTO sign — skating rink in winter.

activities.name: Hockey Hall of Fame
activities.description: The Stanley Cup and interactive exhibits celebrating hockey history — a must for sports fans.

activities.name: Queen Street West
activities.description: Shopping and cafe crawl through one of the world's coolest streets.

activities.name: Chinatown
activities.description: One of North America's largest Chinatowns — dumplings, bakeries, and late-night eats.

activities.name: Little Italy
activities.description: College Street strip of trattorias, gelato shops, and espresso bars.

activities.name: Pai Northern Thai Kitchen
activities.description: Celebrated northern Thai spot — khao soi and pad gra pow in a lively room.

activities.name: Alo Restaurant
activities.description: Toronto's most acclaimed fine dining — French tasting menu on top of a Victorian townhouse.

activities.name: Lee Restaurant
activities.description: Susur Lee's signature Singapore slaw and modern Asian sharing plates.

activities.name: Bar Raval
activities.description: Gaudí-inspired Spanish pintxos bar with serious cocktails and standing-room energy.

activities.name: The Drake Hotel
activities.description: West Queen West institution — live music, art shows, and a buzzing rooftop patio.

activities.name: Scotiabank Arena Game Night
activities.description: Catch the Maple Leafs or Raptors in downtown Toronto's electric arena atmosphere.

activities.name: Toronto Zoo
activities.description: One of the world's largest zoos with over 5,000 animals across 700 acres.

activities.name: Kayak the Harbourfront
activities.description: Paddle the inner harbour and around the islands for a fresh view of the skyline.

destinations.name: Panama City
destinations.description: Where the Pacific meets the Caribbean — a skyline city of colonial charm in Casco Viejo, the engineering marvel of the Panama Canal, and rainforest on its doorstep.

activities.name: Casco Viejo Walking Tour
activities.description: Wander the cobbled streets of the UNESCO-listed old quarter — plazas, churches, and pastel facades.

activities.name: Miraflores Locks Visitor Center
activities.description: Watch massive ships transit the Panama Canal from the viewing terraces and IMAX-style exhibits.

activities.name: Panama Canal Partial Transit
activities.description: Half-day boat journey through the Pacific locks — the definitive canal experience.

activities.name: Biomuseo
activities.description: Frank Gehry's colourful biodiversity museum at the Amador Causeway entrance.

activities.name: Amador Causeway
activities.description: Scenic island causeway with bike rentals, marinas, and skyline views over the Pacific.

activities.name: Cinta Costera
activities.description: Bayside beltway turned urban park — jogging paths, basketball courts, and sea breezes.

activities.name: Ancon Hill
activities.description: Steep 45-minute hike to the giant Panamanian flag — sloths, toucans, and panoramic views.

activities.name: Metropolitan Natural Park
activities.description: Rainforest reserve minutes from downtown — monkey and sloth spotting on marked trails.

activities.name: Panama Viejo Ruins
activities.description: Remains of the original 1519 city sacked by pirates, with a climbable cathedral tower.

activities.name: San Blas Islands Day Trip
activities.description: Paradise archipelago of the Guna Yala — white sand, coral reefs, and crystal water.

activities.name: Gatun Lake Monkey Island Tour
activities.description: Boat tour on the canal's lake to see capuchin monkeys, sloths, and crocodiles up close.

activities.name: Embera Village Visit
activities.description: Dugout canoe ride to an indigenous Embera community — dance, crafts, and a traditional lunch.

activities.name: Isla Taboga Day Trip
activities.description: Ferry to the 'Island of Flowers' — beaches, hiking, and fresh seafood an hour from the city.

activities.name: Mercado de Mariscos
activities.description: The fish market — cheap, fresh ceviche cups eaten standing among the day's catch.

activities.name: Fonda Lo Que Hay
activities.description: Modern Panamanian cooking from a celebrated young kitchen — creative, local, fun.

activities.name: Maito
activities.description: Panama's most famous restaurant — elevated takes on Caribbean and Panamanian classics.

activities.name: Donde Jose
activities.description: Intimate tasting-menu restaurant in Casco Viejo telling Panama's story dish by dish.

activities.name: Tantalo Rooftop
activities.description: Lively Casco Viejo rooftop bar with skyline and bay views — happy hour favourite.

activities.name: CasaCasco
activities.description: Five floors of bars and dining in a colonial mansion, crowned by a dance-floor rooftop.

activities.name: Selina Casco Viejo
activities.description: Hostel-bar hybrid with nightly live music, salsa classes, and a backpacker crowd.

activities.name: Teatro Nacional
activities.description: Ornate 1908 opera house with frescoed ceilings — tour or catch a live performance.

activities.name: Iglesia San Jose & Golden Altar
activities.description: Baroque church hiding the golden altar saved from pirate Henry Morgan.

activities.name: Plaza Francia
activities.description: Waterfront plaza honouring the French canal builders — best sunset spot in Casco Viejo.

activities.name: Punta Culebra Nature Center
activities.description: Smithsonian marine centre with tidal pools, sloth forest, and touch tanks for kids.

activities.name: Cafe Unido
activities.description: Panama's specialty coffee pioneer — geisha pour-overs and breakfast plates.

activities.name: La Rana Dorada
activities.description: Craft brewery pub pouring local golden ales and lagers with a lively happy hour.
